executable_actions.on_failure: Keep functional_sim and all downstream board gates blocked. executable_actions.rationale: Repair the board verification capability before hardware diagnosis. Generate a hash-bound board testbench and canonical compile plan from the currently discovered user-supplied sample-project wrapper and Vivado export facts, without editing the wrapper or DUT. The semantic contract must use independent target-model inference for the same immutable checkpoint and stimulus, a complete Transformer-block-only tensor catalog, a fixed numeric policy, generated-testbench hashes, and loader requirements for every required DUT tensor. planned_tool.direct_certified_kernel_boundary_probe is required because the current system lacks the read-only direct-boundary observability requested by prior execution feedback.

consumes: passing current rerun result for case_axi_ddr_interface
executable_actions.on_failure: If execution is again blocked by identity, compile authority, source loading, target-reference, numeric-policy, or loader binding, return to repair.bind_exact_board_harness_and_direct_kernel_probe and do not patch RTL. If VCS executes but reports a value, order, AXI, DDR, lifecycle, or liveness failure, preserve its trace and proceed only to repair.classify_current_board_boundary_trace_and_gate_backtrack; do not promote or reopen a lower layer based solely on wrapper-frontier symptoms.
executable_actions.rationale: After the identity gate passes, execute the first current-layer hardware-facing replay rather than patching RTL. Use the exact generated board testbench and compile plan to collect cycle-correlated direct-kernel ingress/egress handshakes and start/completion lifecycle values together with wrapper-frontier behavior. The replay must retain the immutable target-model expected outputs, tolerance, stimulus, checkpoint, and exact board-wrapper source hashes.

executable_actions.rationale: Convert the current replay into a bounded decision rather than guessing a root module. Distinguish no kernel ingress, accepted ingress without lifecycle launch, internally retained tokens/no direct egress, direct egress blocked at the wrapper, and completed-but-unpropagated output. Preserve the certified elastic pipeline semantics. A lower-layer backtrack is conditional and requires a current hash-bound direct trace containing core start, ingress, egress, a named causal boundary, and an explicit contradiction of a named current lower-layer certificate.

Do not promote to synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI release, or board runtime.

executable_actions.rationale: This action is eligible only when the current VCS replay and causal decision report a semantic pass with complete executed DUT weight consumption, or after the resulting bounded current-layer repair is applied and rerun. Execute the remaining board-layer gates in dependency order and assemble semantic evidence using the immutable exact-board contract. Reconcile Stage7/Stage8 retry requests and trust barriers only from the resulting full current Stage7 evidence; no prior rejected artifact becomes trusted merely because this repair plan exists.

observations: real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface failed because simulation.source_identity_sha256, Vivado-export compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and executable authorization do not bind the current exact sample-project identity. The functional-simulation precondition also reports that verification/board_simulation/board_tb.sv is absent.

functional_sim=fail is dependency-blocked because the VCS functional tool was not run after case_axi_ddr_interface failed. Therefore there is no current board-level claim or root cause concerning values, tolerance, AXI protocol, DDR image, token order, liveness, or lifecycle behavior.

The prior wrapper-frontier observation is historical planning evidence only: its diagnosis is not currently bound because a live source hash changed. Its requested direct kernel-boundary probe is still the smallest evidence-preserving capability needed after static harness binding succeeds; it is not a current contradiction of the connected-kernel certificate.

Hash-validated operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer certificates remain reusable. The connected kernel is certified as an elastic variable-latency pipeline with required boundary order and cross-token overlap; unequal same-token stage timing is not a failure. No current trace directly contradicts either lower-layer certificate, so no lower layer may be reopened.

The board semantic harness must bind a complete Transformer-block-only tensor catalog, immutable input provenance, independent target-model inference expected outputs for that same checkpoint and stimulus, the current resolved numeric policy, generated testbench hashes, and an executed complete-scope DUT weight-consumption report. Embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling remain outside the DUT and its golden/weight requirements.

sacg_memory_truth reports 15 active contamination barriers and six open retry requests in this hierarchy scope, including retry_request.0143 and retry_request.0144 for the latest case_axi_ddr_interface/functional_sim failure. Rejected Stage7 and Stage8 artifacts are planning/debug evidence only and cannot promote. The scoped truth reports zero open backtrack requests; the omitted global cross-layer backtrack count is not executable in this scope.
The conditional design-team review was no_split. It adds no alternate repair authority and does not replace required real-tool evidence.
proposed_actions: Rebuild the board semantic testbench and canonical VCS compile plan from the current discovered exact sample-project identity, bind all semantic artifacts and source hashes, and add only read-only direct-kernel boundary observability.
Rerun case_axi_ddr_interface; do not launch VCS or alter DUT/wrapper RTL unless the exact-board identity and compile-authority gate passes.

Run one hash-bound VCS targeted replay that records direct kernel start, input valid/ready/acceptance, output valid/ready/acceptance, and wrapper frontier behavior while retaining the immutable target-model comparison contract.

Classify the earliest current causal boundary from that replay. Repair only the resulting board integration slice; create a lower-layer backtrack request solely if the trace explicitly contradicts a named current lower-layer certificate.

Only after the replay is semantically passing, execute the remaining board-layer gate DAG, assemble board semantic evidence, and reconcile SACG retry/barrier state from the new Stage7 result. Otherwise retain fail-closed status.
risks: A compile plan that is not bound to the current exact board identity can simulate an unauthorized wrapper, source set, executable, or Vivado context; a passing substitute would not establish board correctness.

Changing the checkpoint, stimulus, target-model oracle, expected outputs, numeric policy, tolerance, testbench contract, exact wrapper hashes, or generated board source binding during this loop would contaminate the comparison. Frozen framework defaults may be recorded only if a tolerance field was initially absent, never inferred from DUT output.

A wrapper output-frontier stall or independent AXI/prefetch progress alone does not prove kernel failure. Reopening the certified kernel without current hash-bound start, ingress, egress, named-boundary, and certificate-contradiction evidence would violate the hierarchical repair loop.

The board boundary contract can still fail across model tensor scope, shape/packing, quantization/numeric policy, stream data order, DDR addressing and weight loading, AXI backpressure, lifecycle/start-complete behavior, implementation source identity, and exact board-wrapper integration. Each must remain traceable in the repaired harness.

The direct certified-kernel boundary probe is a currently missing observability capability. Until it is implemented as read-only generated-testbench instrumentation and validated against the exact source identity, no causal RTL or wrapper replacement is justified.

constraints: exact user-supplied board wrapper and simulation source hashes must bind the current identity and Vivado export facts
checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric comparison policy, tolerance, and testbench contract remain immutable during repair
complete-scope Transformer-block tensor hashes and executed DUT loader consumption are required; model-tail tensors are out of scope
passed lower layers may be reopened only by a current hash-bound direct contradiction
active SACG trust barriers and retry requests block promotion until a new Stage7 result passes
edges: exact sample-project identity and Vivado export facts -> identity-bound board simulation manifest -> canonical VCS compile plan

target checkpoint, deterministic stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, and complete Transformer-block tensor catalog -> hashed semantic testbench and loader requirements -> executed DUT weight-consumption evidence
wrapper ingress -> resolved direct kernel input -> resolved direct kernel output -> wrapper output/lifecycle frontier
current direct boundary trace with a named certificate contradiction -> conditional lower-layer backtrack; otherwise -> current board-layer repair only
